heuristics.name: classic-headword gloss
heuristics.description: Pick the option that is the plain-English gloss of a well-known ISEE-upper headword (e.g. meticulous->painstaking, indefatigable->tireless, intermittent->sporadic). Distractors in these sets are same-part-of-speech, same-register, so this is the only signal.

heuristics.name: odd-register option
heuristics.description: When one option is unusually phrased or archaic as an everyday word (moneyed, upbraid), treat it as a gloss chosen for a hard headword.

heuristics.name: pure guess among equals
heuristics.description: No option stood out; picked the most commonly tested sense.

notes: Option sets are well matched (same POS, similar frequency); no structural tell found. All picks basis=guess; no option could be ruled out with certainty, since any of the four words could be the gloss of some headword.
